why: This is what F2 really does in VS Code with its default 'Use Aliases For Renames' setting: the export becomes scaleRecipe and scale.js's import becomes { scaleRecipe as scale }, so the calls in scale.js keep the local name scale. The rename is complete and correct (the imported binding is scaleRecipe) and node scale.js prints all six doubled amounts.

step.title: Rename scale to scaleRecipe and run it
step.instructions: Put the cursor on scale in recipe-utils.js, press F2, type scaleRecipe and press Enter. VS Code renames it in recipe-utils.js and in scale.js. Then run node scale.js: it prints six doubled amounts.

checks.label: node scale.js prints the doubled amounts

hints: F2 renames a symbol in every file that uses it; Find and Replace only changes the open file.
common_mistakes: Renaming the function by hand and leaving the old name in scale.js's import.
